<!--
  HOW TO ADD A PHOTO
  1. Grab the date/camera/lens/exposure info for the caption text
     (macOS Spotlight metadata):
       sips -g creation your-photo.JPG
       mdls -name kMDItemModel -name kMDItemLensModel -name kMDItemFocalLength \
            -name kMDItemFNumber -name kMDItemExposureTimeSeconds -name kMDItemISOSpeed your-photo.JPG
  2. Resize the long edge to 2000px and convert to webp in one step
     with cwebp alone, at a flat quality of 65 regardless of resulting
     file size. `sips` is deliberately NOT used here — it strips EXIF
     on resize, whereas cwebp's -metadata flag copies it straight into
     the webp. Use `-resize 2000 0` if the photo is landscape (wider
     than tall), or `-resize 0 2000` if portrait (taller than wide):
       cwebp -resize 2000 0 -metadata all -q 65 your-photo.JPG -o assets/images/photos/your-photo.webp
  3. Add a line below in the form (the trailing backslash puts the
     exif info on its own line under the location/note; for a zoom
     lens use the focal length actually shot at, not the lens range).
     No attributes needed — photo-grid.lua handles everything else
     automatically: it reads each image's real size off disk to
     reserve the right amount of space (so the grid doesn't shuffle
     around as photos finish loading) and puts every photo in the
     same lightbox gallery (so the arrows can step between them):
       ![Location · Mon Day, Year — brief note on the occasion.\
       *Camera · Lens · focal length, shutter, f-stop, ISO*](assets/images/photos/your-photo.webp)
-->
